annotations.title: QR code generator: PNG and SVG

description: Turn a URL or any text into a QR code, returned as an SVG and a PNG in one call. Choose the error-correction level and size. Use it when: You need a scannable QR code for a link, a Wi-Fi string, a payment request or any text, ready to drop into a page, print or image. Not for: Reading or decoding existing QR codes, or styled codes with colors and logos. Returns: The SVG markup and a PNG as a data URL, plus the QR version and error-correction level used. Typical time: about 1 s. Price: $0.002 per QR code, charged only on success. One call = one QR code as PNG and SVG.

ecc.description: Error correction: L (most data) to H (survives damage or a logo). Default M

text.description: The URL or text to encode
